Flow is one-sided: 50 NEAR of buys, zero sells, so the tax base is healthy and there is no sell pressure to fight. Keep tax_bps at 240 — no reason to cut into revenue when demand is strong, no reason to raise and risk damping buys. Split stays 60/20/20: endowment covers inference with a growing buffer (10.5 NEAR), lockers earn a steady 20% on 320.5M weight-days, and the buyback fund accumulates. Fund stands at 0.2793 NEAR; at price 0.00000779 that buys ~35.8k CHAIR. Two basis points of supply is ~27,050 CHAIR (~0.211 NEAR), which the fund covers; three would not. Burn 2 bps this meeting, leaving a small residue to seed the next cycle. No petitions to answer.","answers":[]}
